senses.definitionEn: to describe something as being smaller, less important, or less serious than it actually is
senses.definitionZh: 輕描淡寫；低調陳述（少於實際情況）
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見片語 it would be an understatement to say...；與 exaggerate（誇大）相對。

examples.en: He tends to understate his own accomplishments.
examples.zh: 他傾向於輕描淡寫自己的成就。

synonyms.noteZh: 降低描述中的重要性或嚴重性

senses.definitionEn: a statement that describes something as less important or serious than it really is
senses.definitionZh: 輕描淡寫的說法；保守的陳述
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見片語 that's an understatement（那真是輕描淡寫了），用來強調實際情況比所述更嚴重。

examples.en: To say the trip was difficult would be an understatement.
examples.zh: 說這趟旅程「困難」實在是太輕描淡寫了。

synonyms.noteZh: 淡化嚴重性或重要性的表述

senses.definitionEn: to commit oneself to and begin a task or responsibility; to promise or guarantee to do something
senses.definitionZh: 著手進行；承擔（任務）；承諾
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 undertake a project/task/responsibility；語氣正式，強調正式承接某項工作或義務。

examples.en: The government has undertaken a major infrastructure project.
examples.zh: 政府已著手進行一項重大的基礎建設計畫。

senses.definitionEn: to accept financial responsibility for something, guaranteeing payment in case of loss; to sponsor or finance
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見於金融、保險語境，如 underwrite a loan/insurance policy，指承擔財務風險或提供資金支持。

examples.en: The bank agreed to underwrite the company's new bond issue.
examples.zh: 這家銀行同意為公司的新債券發行提供承保。

synonyms.noteZh: 在財務義指保證承擔風險

senses.definitionEn: to reverse or cancel an action, especially a recent one; to unfasten something
senses.definitionZh: 撤銷；復原；解開（扣子、繩結等）
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 undo a mistake（Ctrl+Z 常用於電腦軟體）、undo a button（解開鈕扣），依語境判斷。

examples.en: She quickly pressed Ctrl+Z to undo her last change.
examples.zh: 她迅速按下 Ctrl+Z 復原了最後一次修改。

synonyms.noteZh: 在撤銷義指使效果回復

antonyms.noteZh: 在解開義指扣緊或繫牢

senses.definitionEn: beyond question or dispute, as anyone would have to accept
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常置於句首或句中，用來加強語氣，表達說話者對某件事極為確信。

examples.en: He is undoubtedly one of the best players in the league.
examples.zh: 他無疑是聯盟中最優秀的球員之一。

senses.definitionEn: feeling or causing anxiety or discomfort; not settled or secure
senses.definitionZh: 不安的；焦慮的；不穩定的
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 an uneasy feeling/silence/truce；強調心理層面隱約的擔憂或局勢的不穩定。

examples.en: There was an uneasy silence in the room after the announcement.
examples.zh: 公告發布後，房間裡陷入一陣令人不安的沉默。

senses.definitionEn: not having a paid job but able to work
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 unemployed workers、the unemployed（失業者，作集合名詞用）；為勞動市場常用詞彙。

examples.en: Thousands of workers became unemployed after the factory closed.
examples.zh: 工廠關閉後，數千名工人失業了。

synonyms.noteZh: 沒有工作且通常正在求職的

senses.definitionEn: not based on or behaving according to the principles of equality and justice
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 an unfair advantage/decision；與 fair 相對，強調違反公平正義原則。

examples.en: It's unfair to blame him for something he didn't do.
examples.zh: 把他沒做過的事怪罪在他身上是不公平的。

senses.definitionEn: to open out something that was folded; (of a story or situation) to gradually develop or become known
senses.definitionZh: 展開；（故事或情況）逐漸展現、發展
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 unfold a map（展開地圖）、events unfold（事件逐漸展開），依語境判斷字面義或比喻義。

examples.en: The plot slowly unfolds over the course of the novel.
examples.zh: 劇情在小說的過程中慢慢展開。

senses.definitionEn: not based on fact; having no foundation
senses.definitionZh: 沒有根據的；無憑無據的
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 unfounded rumors/claims/fears；強調某項說法或擔憂缺乏事實依據。

examples.en: The rumors about the company's bankruptcy turned out to be unfounded.
examples.zh: 關於這家公司破產的謠言最後證實是沒有根據的。

senses.definitionEn: a distinctive set of clothing worn by members of a particular group, such as an organization or school
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 school/military uniform、wear a uniform；指特定團體成員統一穿著的服裝。

examples.en: All students are required to wear a uniform at this school.
examples.zh: 這所學校要求所有學生都要穿制服。

senses.definitionEn: not changing in form or character; the same throughout
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 uniform standards/temperature；強調各部分或各時間點皆保持相同、無差異。

examples.en: The company enforces uniform pricing across all its stores.
examples.zh: 這家公司在所有分店都實施統一的定價。

antonyms.noteZh: 在形容詞義指會變動的

senses.definitionEn: done by or affecting only one country, group, or person, without the agreement of others involved
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 unilateral action/decision，多用於政治、外交語境，強調未經其他相關方同意即採取行動。

examples.en: The country took unilateral action without consulting its allies.
examples.zh: 這個國家未與盟友協商便採取了單方面行動。

senses.definitionEn: being the only one of its kind; unlike anything else
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 a unique opportunity/style；嚴格來說 unique 為絕對形容詞，理論上不可加程度副詞修飾（如 very unique），但口語中常見此用法。

examples.en: Every snowflake has a unique pattern.
examples.zh: 每片雪花都有獨特的圖案。

senses.definitionEn: the state of being united or joined as a whole; agreement of purpose or feeling
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 national unity、a sense of unity；強調群體之間的凝聚力或共同目標。

examples.en: The crisis brought a new sense of unity to the community.
examples.zh: 這場危機為社區帶來了一種新的團結感。

senses.definitionEn: relating to or done by all people or things in the world or in a particular group; applicable to all cases
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 a universal truth/language；強調適用於所有人、事、時間，不受限於特定範圍。

examples.en: Access to clean water should be a universal right.
examples.zh: 取得乾淨水源應該是普世的權利。

senses.definitionEn: a general concept or term that applies to all members of a class
senses.definitionZh: 普遍性事物；共通的原則
senses.usageExplanationZh: 名詞用法較少見，多見於哲學語境，指適用於所有事例的抽象概念。

examples.en: Philosophers have long debated whether moral universals exist.
examples.zh: 哲學家長期以來一直在辯論道德上是否存在普遍原則。

synonyms.noteZh: 在普遍義指到處存在的

antonyms.noteZh: 在共通原則義指特定個別的

senses.definitionEn: all existing matter and space considered as a whole; the cosmos
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 the vastness of the universe、the origin of the universe；為天文學及日常用語中常見的核心詞彙。

examples.en: Scientists are still trying to understand the origins of the universe.
examples.zh: 科學家仍在試圖了解宇宙的起源。

senses.definitionEn: not likely to happen or be true; improbable
senses.definitionZh: 不太可能的；不像會發生的
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 it is unlikely that...；也可用於片語 an unlikely hero/friendship，指出乎意料的組合。

examples.en: It is unlikely to rain tomorrow according to the forecast.
examples.zh: 根據預報，明天不太可能下雨。

senses.definitionEn: not affected emotionally by something; remaining in the same physical position
senses.definitionZh: 不為所動的；無動於衷的；未被移動的
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 remain unmoved by something，強調對他人的懇求或悲劇無動於衷，語氣可帶批評意味。

examples.en: The judge remained unmoved by the defendant's tearful apology.
examples.zh: 法官對被告含淚的道歉無動於衷。

synonyms.noteZh: 在情緒義指未受影響的

antonyms.noteZh: 在情緒義指受到感動的

senses.definitionEn: not producing much or any result; not achieving intended results
senses.definitionZh: 無生產力的；徒勞無功的
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 an unproductive meeting/day；與 productive 相對，強調缺乏實質成果或效益。

examples.en: The meeting was long and unproductive, with no decisions made.
examples.zh: 這場會議冗長又徒勞無功，沒有做出任何決定。

senses.definitionEn: not having the necessary qualifications or skills for a task; complete and absolute
senses.definitionZh: 不合格的；不夠資格的；（表達上）毫無保留的
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 unqualified for the job（缺乏資格）、an unqualified success（毫無保留的成功），兩義項需依上下文判斷。

collocations.meaningZh: 不具備這份工作的資格

examples.en: He was unqualified for the position due to a lack of experience.
examples.zh: 他因缺乏經驗而不符合這個職位的資格。

synonyms.noteZh: 在資格義指能力不足的

senses.definitionEn: to undo or separate the threads of something woven or knitted; to investigate and solve a mystery or explain something complicated
senses.definitionZh: 解開（線團、謎團）；解決；使鬆散
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 unravel a mystery/plot（解開謎團）、a sweater begins to unravel（毛衣開始鬆脫）。

examples.en: Detectives worked for months to unravel the mystery behind the murders.
examples.zh: 偵探們花了數月時間解開這幾起謀殺案背後的謎團。

synonyms.noteZh: 解開纏繞的線或複雜問題

senses.definitionEn: not controlled or governed by rules or regulations
senses.definitionZh: 未受規範的；不受管制的
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 an unregulated market/industry，多用於經濟、金融語境，指缺乏政府或機構的監督管理。

examples.en: Cryptocurrency remains a largely unregulated market in many countries.
examples.zh: 在許多國家，加密貨幣市場在很大程度上仍不受監管。

senses.definitionEn: a state of dissatisfaction, disturbance, and agitation among a group of people, often leading to protest
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 social/political/civil unrest；為不可數名詞，強調集體性的不滿與騷動，常見於新聞報導。

examples.en: The country has experienced widespread civil unrest in recent months.
examples.zh: 這個國家近幾個月來經歷了大規模的社會動盪。

senses.definitionEn: having or showing no moral principles; not honest or fair
senses.definitionZh: 不擇手段的；肆無忌憚的；不講道德的
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見搭配 an unscrupulous businessman/lender；強調為達目的不惜違反道德或法律規範。

examples.en: Unscrupulous lenders often target vulnerable, low-income families.
examples.zh: 不擇手段的放款人經常鎖定弱勢的低收入家庭下手。

wordFamily.meaningZh: 一絲不苟的；嚴謹正直的

senses.definitionEn: to make someone feel anxious or uneasy
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見 be unsettled by something，強調事件或消息造成的心理不安，語氣正式。

examples.en: The strange noise unsettled the children.
examples.zh: 那個奇怪的聲音使孩子們感到不安。

senses.definitionEn: too great or too many to be counted or measured
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 damage、wealth、suffering 等抽象名詞，強調程度極大，語氣書面。

examples.en: The war caused untold suffering to civilians.
examples.zh: 這場戰爭為平民帶來了難以計數的苦難。

senses.definitionEn: not told or made public
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見 an untold story（未被說出的故事），強調事情尚未被公開或講述。

examples.en: This is the untold story of the mission's true cost.
examples.zh: 這是這次任務真正代價那段未被說出的故事。

antonyms.noteZh: 在未透露義指已揭露的

senses.definitionEn: to show or announce something publicly for the first time
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見 unveil a plan/product/statue，指首次向大眾展示或公布某事物。

examples.en: The company unveiled its latest smartphone at the conference.
examples.zh: 這家公司在大會上發表了其最新款智慧型手機。

synonyms.noteZh: 使原先隱藏的事物公開

senses.definitionEn: not justified or authorized; unnecessary
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 criticism、attack、fear 等，強調缺乏合理理由的行為或情緒。

examples.en: Her harsh criticism of the intern was completely unwarranted.
examples.zh: 她對這名實習生的嚴厲批評完全沒有道理。

senses.definitionEn: a piece of new information about a situation, or a new version of software
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見 give an update（提供最新消息）、software update（軟體更新），資訊科技語境常用。

examples.en: Please send me an update on the project's progress.
examples.zh: 請把專案進度的最新消息寄給我。

senses.definitionEn: to give someone the latest information, or to make something more modern or current
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見 update a file/record，也可指告知某人最新情況，如 update someone on。

examples.en: She updated the software to fix the security bug.
examples.zh: 她更新了軟體以修復這個安全漏洞。

synonyms.noteZh: 在動詞義指修訂內容以符合新資訊

senses.definitionEn: an improvement or addition that makes something better or more advanced
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見 a free upgrade、software upgrade，指設備、系統或服務等級的提升。

examples.en: He received a free upgrade to business class on his flight.
examples.zh: 他這趟航班獲得免費升等到商務艙。

synonyms.noteZh: 在名詞義指改良版本或提升

senses.definitionEn: to confirm or support something, especially a law, decision, or principle
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見 uphold the law/a decision，強調堅定支持既有規範或裁決，語氣正式。

examples.en: The court upheld the original verdict on appeal.
examples.zh: 法院在上訴時維持了原判決。

synonyms.noteZh: 堅持或維持原則及裁決

senses.definitionEn: vertical or in a straight position, or honest and morally correct
senses.usageExplanationZh: 物理義指姿勢挺直，如 sit upright；比喻義形容人品行端正，如 an upright citizen。

examples.en: Please keep your seat in the upright position during takeoff.
examples.zh: 起飛時請將椅背保持在直立位置。

senses.definitionEn: relating to a city or densely populated area
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見 urban area/planning/life，與 rural（鄉村的）相對。

examples.en: The city government focused on improving urban public transport.
examples.zh: 市政府致力於改善都市大眾運輸系統。

synonyms.noteZh: 與大都市有關的，範圍較窄

senses.definitionEn: to strongly encourage or advise someone to do something
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常接 urge someone to do something，語氣比 encourage 更強烈、更急迫。

examples.en: Doctors urged the public to get vaccinated before winter.
examples.zh: 醫生們敦促民眾在冬季來臨前接種疫苗。

senses.definitionEn: a strong desire or impulse to do something
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見 have an urge to do something，指難以壓抑的內心衝動。

examples.en: She felt a sudden urge to laugh during the meeting.
examples.zh: 她在會議中突然有股想笑的衝動。

senses.definitionEn: the quality of requiring immediate action or attention
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見 a sense of urgency（急迫感），強調事情需要立即處理的程度。

examples.en: The doctor's tone conveyed a real sense of urgency.
examples.zh: 醫生的語氣傳達出真正的急迫感。

synonyms.noteZh: 指情況的緊迫性，屬正式用語

senses.definitionEn: requiring immediate action or attention
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 matter、message、need，強調不能拖延、需立刻處理。

examples.en: She left the meeting to take an urgent phone call.
examples.zh: 她離開會議去接一通緊急電話。

senses.definitionEn: the way in which a word or phrase is used, or the amount of something used
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見 word usage（詞語用法）、water usage（用水量），依語境略有不同。

examples.en: The dictionary gives examples of correct word usage.
examples.zh: 這本字典提供了正確用詞的例句。

senses.definitionEn: not fulfilling or not able to fulfill the intended purpose or function
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常接 useless at/for，也可用於自嘲或抱怨，如 I'm useless at cooking。

examples.en: This old phone is useless without a charger.
examples.zh: 沒有充電器的話，這支舊手機就沒用了。

senses.definitionEn: to take a position of power or authority illegally or by force
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見 usurp the throne/power，語氣正式，多用於政治或歷史情境。

examples.en: The general usurped the throne after a violent coup.
examples.zh: 這名將軍在一場暴力政變後篡奪了王位。

synonyms.noteZh: 以強力奪取；不一定涉及非法繼位

senses.definitionEn: designed to be useful or practical rather than attractive
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常修飾 design、furniture，強調重視實用性勝過美觀，語氣中性偏正式。

examples.en: The building's utilitarian design prioritizes function over beauty.
examples.zh: 這棟建築物採用實用主義的設計，重視功能勝過美觀。

senses.definitionEn: a person who believes actions should be judged by their usefulness or benefit to the majority
senses.usageExplanationZh: 哲學用語，指主張以行為對多數人利益之貢獻來評斷道德價值的人。

examples.en: As a utilitarian, she judges policies by their overall benefit to society.
examples.zh: 身為功利主義者，她以政策對整體社會的效益來評判其優劣。

synonyms.noteZh: 在實用義指重視用途的

senses.definitionEn: the state of being useful, or a public service such as electricity or water
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見 public utility（公用事業，如水電瓦斯），也可泛指某物的實用價值。

examples.en: The gadget's utility outweighs its high price.
examples.zh: 這個裝置的實用性超過了它高昂的價格。

synonyms.noteZh: 在實用性義指有用程度

senses.definitionEn: to make practical and effective use of something
senses.usageExplanationZh: 語氣比 use 更正式，常見於書面或商業情境，如 utilize resources。

examples.en: The team utilized every available resource to meet the deadline.
examples.zh: 這個團隊利用了每一項可用的資源以趕上截止期限。

senses.definitionEn: to say something, especially something brief
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見 utter a word/sound，語氣正式，強調開口說話這個動作本身。

examples.en: He didn't utter a single word during the entire meeting.
examples.zh: 他在整場會議中一句話都沒說。

senses.definitionEn: a spoken word, statement, or vocal sound
senses.usageExplanationZh: 語言學或正式書面用語，指說出口的話語或聲音單位。

examples.en: Her every utterance was recorded for the official transcript.
examples.zh: 她的每一句發言都被記錄下來作為正式文字紀錄。

senses.definitionEn: completely and totally
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常修飾負面形容詞，如 utterly ridiculous/exhausted，語氣強烈。

examples.en: The plan was utterly ridiculous from the start.
examples.zh: 這項計畫從一開始就完全荒謬。

senses.definitionEn: an available job position, or an unoccupied room in a hotel
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見 job vacancy、hotel vacancy，指目前無人佔用或未被填補的位置。

examples.en: The hotel had no vacancies during the holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 這家飯店在假日週末沒有空房。

synonyms.noteZh: 在職缺義指待補的職位

senses.definitionEn: to give someone a vaccine to protect against a disease
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見 vaccinate against，指施打疫苗以預防特定疾病，語氣中性醫學用語。

examples.en: Parents are encouraged to vaccinate their children against measles.
examples.zh: 家長們被鼓勵讓孩子接種麻疹疫苗。

synonyms.noteZh: 使產生免疫力；接種為其中一種方式

senses.definitionEn: a substance used to stimulate immunity to a disease
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常見 receive/develop a vaccine，指用來預防疾病的醫學製劑。

examples.en: Scientists developed a new vaccine in record time.
examples.zh: 科學家們以破紀錄的速度研發出一款新疫苗。

senses.definitionEn: to waver between different opinions or actions; to be indecisive
senses.usageExplanationZh: 常接 vacillate between A and B，語氣書面，強調難以做出決定的狀態。

examples.en: He vacillated between accepting and rejecting the job offer.
examples.zh: 他在接受與拒絕這份工作邀約之間猶豫不決。
